# [TASK] Audit Epics #1, #10, #15 and #22 in Epic mode

## Task
Audit epics #1, #10, #15 and #22 in epic mode
(`/audit-artifacts epic <n>`).

One task covers all four. Epic #15 parents two stories in this batch (#85,
#86) and epic #22 parents three (#87, #88, #89). If each story task also
rewrote its epic, two or three tasks would write over the same body. A story
run may only tick a box in its epic; the rewrite happens here.

Runs after #255 to #261. An epic's child-stories list is only correct once
its stories are audited.

Finding already recorded: #1 is titled "[EPIC] Project Setup Phase", which
names a position in a schedule rather than what the epic delivers.

## No parent
Unparented when #252 was closed as superseded. Kept out of the new structure
on purpose: the work it described now lives on #268, #269, #270 and #271.

## Scope
Epics #1, #10, #15 and #22 only. The remaining 8 epics belong to later
batches under #251.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Given this task was superseded before delivery, when #251 was
      restructured, then auditing an epic body became a criterion on that
      epic's own story (#268, #269, #270, #271), and epic #1's audit under
      this task's scope is recorded on #268

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Notes
Gate 4 does not apply. The epic template has no acceptance-criteria
section, so the child-stories list is the surface that gets checked.
